title: console: a related-list tab's count badge stops updating after a row action — a later delete leaves the tab at the old number while the list shows the new one
body:
## What happens

On a record page, the count badge on a related-list tab stops following the list after a row action has run in that list. The list itself (rows and its own "All N" chip) is correct; only the tab badge keeps the old number until the page is reloaded.

Measured in a browser on `@objectstack/*` 18.6.0 (console at `/_console`), zh-CN, as an org admin, on a parent record whose related list is a master-detail child with one row action (a flow-free `update` action) and the standard row menu (Edit / Delete).

## Steps

1. Open a record page on its related tab (`…/record/<id>?related=<child>.<lookup>`). Tab reads `<Child> 9`, the list chip reads `All 9`.
2. On one row, open the row menu and run the object's row action (here: "Mark as responded", which updates that row's status). Success toast shows; the row updates. Tab still `9`, chip `All 9` (correct, nothing was removed).
3. On another row, open the row menu → Delete → confirm.

## Actual

- The row is gone, the list shows 8 rows, the chip reads `All 8`.
- The tab badge still reads `9`, and stays there (checked again 7 s later, and after a further delete attempt on the parent).
- A full reload shows `8`.

Seen twice with the same sequence (11 → list 10 / badge 11; 9 → list 8 / badge 9).

## Control

Same page, fresh load, no row action first: delete a row, then delete another. The badge follows both times (10 → 9, then 8 → 7 → 6). So a plain delete refreshes the badge; it is the row action before it that breaks the refresh.

## Expected

The tab badge and the list's own count always agree after any write made from that list (row action, delete, create), without a reload.

## Reach

Anyone who works a related list from the record page: after one row action, every later delete in that list leaves the tab showing a number the list contradicts. Not checked: whether a create from the related list's New after a row action is also missed, and whether a header (record-level) action has the same effect.

## Dedupe

Searched open and closed issues for "related tab count stale", "related list count badge delete", "tab count badge delete row", "数量角标". Nearest is #36822 (badge blanks for a moment when a refetch answers zero rows), which is a different symptom: here the badge is never refetched at all.
